resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Generators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b]Generators [/b]are a type of iterable, like lists or tuples. 
Unlike lists, they don't allow indexing with arbitrary indices, but they can still be iterated through with [b]for[/b] loops. 
They can be created using functions and the [b]yield [/b]statement.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="388"]def countdown():
  i=5
  while i > 0:
    [b]yield [/b]i
    i -= 1
    
for i in countdown():
  print(i)[/code]
[note]The [b]yield [/b]statement is used to define a generator, replacing the return of a function to provide a result to its caller without destroying local variables.[/note]

[s0l0!-header][h1]Generators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Due to the fact that they [b]yield [/b]one item at a time, generators don't have the memory restrictions of lists. 
In fact, they can be [b]infinite![/b][code format="py" ]def infinite_sevens():
  while True:
    yield 7
        
for i in infinite_sevens():
  print(i)[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="raw" ]>>>
7
7
7
7
7
7
7
...[/code]
[note]In short, [b]generators [/b]allow you to declare a function that behaves like an iterator, i.e. it can be used in a [b]for [/b]loop.[/note]

resolved.title: 生成器 Generator
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Generators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Finite generators can be converted into lists by passing them as arguments to the [b]list [/b]function.[code format="py" codeId="390"]def numbers(x):
  for i in range(x):
    if i % 2 == 0:
      yield i

print(list(numbers(11)))[/code]
[note]Using [b]generators [/b]results in improved performance, which is the result of the lazy (on demand) generation of values, which translates to lower memory usage. Furthermore, we do not need to wait until all the elements have been generated before we start to use them. [/note]

content.text: 如果是有限生成器则可以将它们作为参数传递给**list**函数来转换为列表。
content.text_html:
Finite generators can be converted into lists by passing them as arguments to the **list **function.

有限生成器可以通过将它们作为参数传递给**list **函数来转换为列表。

content.text: 使用**生成器**异步是为提高了性能，懒惰生成需要的值，从而降低的内存的使用。此外，我们不需要等所有的元素都被生成后再开始使用。
content.text_html:
Using **generators **results in improved performance, which is the result of the lazy (on demand) generation of values, which translates to lower memory usage. Furthermore, we do not need to wait until all the elements have been generated before we start to use them.

使用**生成器的结果是提高了性能，这是懒惰（按需）生成值的结果，这就转化为较低的内存使用。此外，我们不需要等到所有的元素都被生成后再开始使用它们。

resolved.title: 素数生成器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
寻找**素数**是常见的编码面试题。
给定代码已定义一个函数**isPrime(x)**，如果`x`是质数，返回`True`，否则返回`False`。

你需要编写一个生成器函数**primeGenerator()**，它将接受两个数字作为参数，并使用`isPrime()`函数来输出给定范围内（两个参数之间）的素数。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Generators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Finding [b]prime numbers[/b] is a common coding interview task.
The given code defines a function [b]isPrime(x)[/b], which returns True if x is prime.
You need to create a generator function [b]primeGenerator()[/b], that will take two numbers as arguments, and use the isPrime() function to output the prime numbers in the given range (between the two arguments).

[b]Sample Input[/b]
10
20

[b]Sample Output[/b]
[11, 13, 17, 19]

[note]The given code takes the two arguments as input and passes them to the generator function, outputting the result as a list.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 给定的代码将两个参数作为输入，并传递给生成器函数`primeGenerator`，将结果输出为一个列表。
